tickets.title: Run a controlled RF characterization for firmware 1.4.2 (outdoor
tickets.body: Run a controlled RF characterization for firmware 1.4.2 (outdoor, body-block, commuting conditions) to test whether the shortened supervision timeout and retry backoff reproduce the field-scale disconnect increase seen in telemetry.
tickets.routing_rationale: This test requires designing and executing controlled RF characterization comparing firmware versions, which needs expertise in BLE radio link behavior (supervision timeout, connection retry/backoff dynamics) under real-world RF conditions, plus firmware build knowledge to reproduce and instrument the exact 1.4.2 vs 1.4.1 timing behavior, and RTOS-level understanding of how connection supervision and retry scheduling are implemented on-device. Priya Nair selected: overlap firmware-build, ble-radio, rtos; under capacity; roster order as remaining tie.

tickets.title: Flag firmware 1.4.2's BLE supervisor-timing change as a candidate
tickets.body: Flag firmware 1.4.2's BLE supervisor-timing change as a candidate rollback/hotfix target pending the RF characterization results.
tickets.routing_rationale: Assessing a candidate rollback/hotfix for a BLE supervisor-timeout and retry-backoff change requires expertise in BLE connection/radio behavior under varying RF conditions, firmware build and versioning practices to prepare and validate a rollback or hotfix, and RTOS/timing knowledge to evaluate the supervisor-timeout and backoff logic implicated in the disconnect pattern. Priya Nair selected: overlap firmware-build, ble-radio, rtos; under capacity; roster order as remaining tie.

tickets.title: Tag this ticket cluster as a duplicate of KI-UI-011 in the support
tickets.body: Tag this ticket cluster as a duplicate of KI-UI-011 in the support queue so agents route it as a known cosmetic UI issue rather than escalating as a thermal safety concern.
tickets.routing_rationale: Tagging this ticket cluster as a known cosmetic UI duplicate requires someone versed in the app's UI/UX behavior (to confirm the red battery-chrome misread pattern maps to KI-UI-011) and in support-ticket data quality/classification practices (to verify tagging conventions, co-tag logic, and ensure the routing rule won't misclassify a residual thermal subpopulation still under review). Samira El-Sayed selected: overlap data-quality; under capacity; roster order as remaining tie.
